You can calculate your Net Promoter Score online using the [Net Promoter Score Calculator](https://npscalculator.com/).[[1]](https://npscalculator.com/)

### The NPS Formula

- **Promoters (Score 9–10):** Loyal enthusiasts who keep buying and refer others.
- **Passives (Score 7–8):** Satisfied but unenthusiastic customers who can be swayed by competitors.
- **Detractors (Score 0–6):** Unhappy customers who can damage your brand through negative word-of-mouth.[[1]](https://www.surveymonkey.com/learn/customer-feedback/nps-calculator/)[[2]](https://www.zoho.com/survey/net-promoter-score-calculator.html)[[3]](https://www.surveymonkey.com/learn/customer-feedback/net-promoter-score-calculation/)

NPS=% Promoters−% Detractors[0.6 .2]NPS equals %  Promoters minus %  Detractors open bracket 0.6 .2 close bracket N P S=%P r o m o t e r s−%D e t r a c t o r s[0.6.2]

### How to Calculate Manually

1. **Count responses** in each group (Promoters, Passives, and Detractors).
2. **Divide** each group's count by the total number of survey responses and multiply by 100 to get percentages.
3. **Subtract** the percentage of Detractors from the percentage of Promoters.
4. **Result:** Your score will fall between -100 and +100.[[1]](https://www.surveymonkey.com/learn/customer-feedback/nps-calculator/)

If you have your **number of Promoters, Passives, and Detractors** , share them here and I can calculate your exact Net Promoter Score for you.
